items.title: Muggsy Spanier Interview, 1961-02-02
items.q: Marvin Saxby on guitar and banjo... To get back to that Friars Inn band

ctx.x: Yeah, and was that Valle Defoe? Valle Defoe. Valle Defoe. Who else was on the date, can you remember?
Valle Defoe, Mel Stitzel, Marvin Saxby on guitar and banjo, and, let's see, trombone player. I can't think of his name. The only guy you told me about. No, it's in the books.

Yeah, it's in the books, and that's the right person in the books and all that. Yeah. Well, you've given that to other people before, I'm sure. Yeah. To get back to that Friars Inn band, what kind of an impression, how did they compare, say, with Joe Oliver's band? Was it similar in style, or a little different, or what?
